blocks.x: Blockchain & Digital Trust for Agri-Food Processing — dlt networks, tokenization and verifiable credentials — shared truth with regulatory teeth applied to the agri-food processing operating unit of Agriculture & Food Systems.

Food processors live on quality, yield and traceability: intake grading, process yield, food-safety evidence and provenance claims. Vision grading, yield analytics and chain-of-custody convert commodity margin into brand margin.

items: Quality grading by inspectors; variance and throughput loss.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Provenance, Traceability & Supply Chain Trust, Blockchain Analytics & Regulatory Compliance, Smart Contract Engineering & Audit from the Blockchain & Digital Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Intake grading, Process yield analytics, Lot traceability) on Achala Ledger and Achala Sentinel. Governance inherits the sector frame — Food safety (HACCP/EU 178/FSMA) among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Credentials users carry — portable, privacy-preserving verification for workforce and customers.
On-chain transparency, operationalized — analytics, Travel Rule and MiCA-aligned controls.
Permissioned networks for multi-party truth — governance, consensus and integration done institutionally.
EUDR-grade custody with regulator interface (claims verified)
